list: The official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase, agreeing with PSNProfiles). Guides are our own words, written for this entry, and say plainly where a place or step is not yet pinned down: the game released 2026-11-19 and no guide here has been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn, and it needs no separate effort: it pops the moment the other 54 are yours. Treat it as the finish line, not a task. Plan around the 100% completion trophy and the missable partner feats instead, because those are the real work; if anything is left at the end, it is one of those, not this one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the game's first mission, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss: follow the on-screen prompts and the story carries you through. This should be among your first trophies, earned within your first session.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions and this pops at the chapter's end. Side content can wait: nothing in Chapter 1 needs doing first, and the chapter trophy cannot be missed as long as you keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this one follows naturally from playing the main story in order. If you wander off into side activities between missions, the chapter still ends the same way, so play at your own pace.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the story is opening up Vice City itself, so expect longer missions and more driving between objectives. Keep following the main mission markers and the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter. This is the home stretch of the story, so before you push through it, clear the missable partner feats listed on the Missables page: the finale follows soon after and partner availability may change once the story ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Before you start it, clear the missable partner feats and anything else that needs a partner or an open story state, because the finale is the natural point of no return in open-world stories. The game itself does not say so in the trophy description, so treat that as a precaution, not a confirmed fact, and keep a save from before the finale just in case.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Mission names appear in the pause menu's mission list, so if you are unsure whether you have done it, check there rather than replaying missions blindly. Story missions are replayable in past games in the series, so a failed attempt costs you nothing but time.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually the big set-pieces of a chapter, so expect a longer mission with a setup and a payoff. Play it through to its end and the trophy pops with the mission complete screen.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. The name suggests a family thread in the story, so follow the mission markers as they come and finish the mission. There is no side requirement hidden in the description: completing the mission is the whole trophy.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. The trophy's title hints at a fall from fame, but the requirement is simple: finish the mission named in the description. Keep an eye on the mission objectives during it, since story missions sometimes hide an optional beat that is easy to walk past.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. This mission shares its location with the Catch Me If You Can trophy, which asks for an unscheduled departure at VCIA, so keep that second trophy in mind while you are at the airport. Finishing the mission itself is all this trophy asks for.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The name reads like a large-scale operation, so expect a combat-heavy mission with plenty of cover and checkpoints. Push through to the mission complete screen and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion as the in-game stats screen counts it. That normally means finishing the story, all stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the other completion-tracked tasks, so open the stats screen and work through whatever it still lists, one category at a time. Do this last: nearly every other trophy feeds into it, and grinding it early wastes effort on things the story would have given you anyway.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts: jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the running total the game tracks. Stunts build up naturally while you drive fast and mess around, so do not grind them early. Check the stats screen late in the game and top up the remainder with repeated jumps off the same ramp or the same stretch of road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 250); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The count of 9 comes from PSN's progress target. The game lists its activities on the map and in menus, so work through them one by one: fishing, races, the shooting range, drone races, the arcade, bowling and the rest. Tick each off as you try it and the trophy pops when the last type is sampled.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 9 activity types); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores you on accuracy and speed, so use a steady weapon you are comfortable with, take the headshots where the challenge allows them, and replay a challenge as many times as it takes: there is no penalty for retrying. Work through the ranges one at a time and note which ones are still below gold, so you are not re-clearing challenges you already finished.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 42 challenges); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at each one, not 14 wins at the same place. Learn one track's corners first, then move on; crashing costs more time than flying cautiously, and a steady line beats a fast one that ends in a wall.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 14 locations); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: different events, not the same one 20 times. Mix race types and locations, and each new event you win adds one to the count. If a race keeps beating you, switch to a different event and come back later with a faster vehicle.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 20); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so land your catches steadily rather than rushing and losing fish. If you lose, challenge him again: losing a fishing challenge costs nothing but time, and there is no limit stated on attempts.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick the shortest game in the arcade and play it to its end: you do not need a high score, just a completion. If the first game you try drags on, quit out and try a different cabinet rather than grinding a game you dislike.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Contact mission strands unlock as the story progresses, so keep checking for Andy's icon on the map and work through his missions in order: the trophy pops at the last one, not the first. If his icon has not appeared yet, keep playing the story and it will show up.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Like the other contact strands, Kenton's missions appear over the course of the story, so follow his icon when it shows and finish the chain. The boat in the trophy's title hints at where his story goes, but the requirement is only to finish his last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is a biker story, so expect rides and road missions as his chain goes on. Work through his missions in order and the trophy pops when his last one is done.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as map icons as you explore, and each strand is a short chain, so finish one before starting the next to keep track of what is done. Eight strands is the count, not eight missions: a strand only counts when its last mission is finished.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 8 strands); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy's strand is about supply, so expect missions built around moving goods and dealing with rivals. Follow his icon, finish the chain in order, and the trophy pops at his last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Work through his missions as his icon appears on the map, in order, and the trophy pops at the end of his chain. If you lose track of where you are in a contact's strand, the map icon and mission list will show the next step.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points, and each one you use adds to the total. Sweep the map region by region — coast, city, swamp and countryside — so you do not lose track of which area you have covered, and use each spot once when you find it rather than trying to remember it for later.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 18 spots); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunts point you at one specific animal, so track it patiently, take the shot when you have a clean line, and do not spook it by rushing in. The trophy is for that one hunt, not for hunting in general, so follow Bret's strand until he gives you the target.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered collectibles, and a set is complete only when you hold every card in it, so keep a checklist of which sets are one or two cards short and hunt those cards specifically. Three finished sets is the count, so you do not need every card in the game, just three full sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 3 sets); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. This is a volume task: use the feature whenever you pass a new spot rather than saving it for a grind at the end. The count is 100 and each new location counts once, so make it a habit during normal play and the total will climb on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 100 locations); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's small side goals, and stunts, feats and activities all feed them, so this builds up alongside everything else. Check the challenges menu late in the game and mop up the easiest remaining ones first, leaving the hard ones for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 50); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, then escape. Get the wanted level up with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and hide until it clears. Do this while a partner is still available in free roam: we flag it missable because partner availability changes as the story ends, though the game does not confirm a cutoff, so do not leave it until after the finale.
trophies.missableNote: Needs a partner beside you in free roam. Do it before the final mission: partner availability may change once the story ends (not yet confirmed in-game).
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Keep the wanted level alive between robberies: drive straight to the next shop and do not let the heat die down. Same partner warning as Hot Together applies here, so do it before the finale, and pick three shops close together to keep the run short.
trophies.missableNote: Needs a partner beside you in free roam, three shops in a row. Do it before the final mission: partner availability may change once the story ends (not yet confirmed in-game).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts, so drive everything you see — parked cars, bikes, boats and anything unusual — rather than sticking to one favourite. The count is 100, and it builds fastest when you are exploring new areas, so it pairs well with the exploration trophy.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 100 vehicles); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the kills before it runs out. A busy shootout with cover nearby is the place to try it: five enemies in the open, one focus, no reloading in the middle if you can help it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 5); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: leave the airport in a vehicle that is not supposed to leave that way. This reads as tied to the VCIA Takedown mission, so attempt it around that mission and keep a save from before it. We flag it missable on that reading, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game, so treat the mission link as our best reading of the description, not a verified fact.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to VCIA Takedown (the Hi-Jacked mission). Attempt it around that mission and keep a save from before it; the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction: get into trouble with Rhino tanks. Pick a fight somewhere tanks respond, survive the encounter, and the trophy should pop when the game registers the moment. If it does not pop on the first try, try a different approach to the wanted level, because the trigger is not spelled out in the official description.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, move slowly, avoid the cameras and the guards' sightlines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again: detection fails the attempt, not the trophy, so there is no penalty for a careful retry.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault is its own job: get in, take the money, and get clear before the law closes in. Five successful escapes is the count, and a failed escape just means trying that vault again. Plan the getaway before you go in, because the escape is the part that decides whether the attempt counts.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 5 vaults); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash, and break away before backup arrives. Trucks roam the roads, so pick a quiet stretch with an easy getaway and a fast car waiting, rather than trying it in the middle of the city.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive or walk into each named area until the game counts it visited: the count is 52. Work through the map systematically — coast, city, swamp and countryside — and the last few are usually small spots you drove past without noticing, so check the map for gaps when you are down to the final areas.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 52 areas); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang's operation is a different location, so you need one per gang, not nine in one place. Clear one gang's operation, then move to the next gang's territory, and keep a note of which gangs you have done so you do not repeat one.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 9 gangs); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view: the trophy is a quiet moment, not a challenge. Any bar on the beachfront should do; if one does not trigger it, try another spot along the beach, since the description names the beach, not a specific bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's front: the glass and the spectacle are the point. Pick a showroom, build speed outside, and drive straight through the frontage. It is a one-moment trophy, so if it does not pop, try a different showroom.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to that alley, bowl a game, and complete the follow-through the game asks for. The alley's name is in the description, so head there directly rather than to any other bowling alley, and finish the game you start.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: this one reads as a social or follower milestone tied to you and your partner. Build the partnership's profile as the game directs and the trophy pops when the appeal target is hit. The exact number is not stated in the official description, so check the in-game prompt when it appears and do not guess at a target the list never gives.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: PSN tracks this to a count of 500. Make choices whenever the game offers them — dialogue picks, mission approaches and small decisions all count. Because choices can be one-time per playthrough, we flag it as at-risk: say yes to choices as they come rather than saving them for later.
trophies.missableNote: Choices can be one-time per playthrough (PSN count: 500). Make choices as they come instead of skipping them; a skipped choice may not come back.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 500 choices); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed at something on a second attempt. Fail a challenge or attempt once, then succeed on the retry, and it pops on the successful second try. Pick something easy to fail and retry on purpose if it has not popped naturally, such as a short race or a simple challenge.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd events, so keep your eyes open while exploring, especially at night and in out-of-the-way places. This one pops when you stumble into the moment, so explore widely rather than hunting one spot the description never names: the description gives no location, and we will not invent one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: hit a pedestrian with a melee swing from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and keep moving. It is a stunt more than a fight, so try it on a quiet road where you can set up the pass without traffic in the way.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so launder them through your contacts in batches and the total adds up. Keep laundering as you earn rather than sitting on a pile of marked bills, and the trophy will pop well before the end of the game if you stay on top of it.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: $250,000); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and upgrades as you play and the total climbs on its own. If you are short late in the game, spend the remainder on expensive items you actually want, such as a good weapon or a vehicle upgrade, rather than throwing money away.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: $100,000); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress, so buy each one when it appears and keep the money aside for them. Eight is the count, and the last one may only appear late in the story, so do not assume you are done after the first few.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 8 garages); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register each vehicle you own or find, and repeat until you reach 10. Any ten vehicles count, so use the cheapest ones you come across, and register each new vehicle as soon as you get it so you do not have to hunt for ten at the end.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress target: 10 vehicles); our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.
